title: One-Week Mediterranean Meal Plan
subtitle: A flexible framework, examples, substitutions, and safety considerations for one-week mediterranean meal plan.
evidence_strength: Established evidence from multiple randomized controlled trials and meta-analyses supports cardiovascular and metabolic benefits of the Mediterranean diet. Emerging studies explore effects on cognitive health and cancer prevention with moderate evidence. Limitations include individual variability and need for adaptation.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
